differences.suspected_cause: ryo flags each unused unpacked binding; Ruff does not when the same name is rebound and read later in the scope (admin/checks.py field, sql/compiler.py alias).
ryo matches the loop target against attribute names in the iterable (for many_to_many in self.opts.many_to_many; for secret in [self.secret, ...]); Ruff matches only bare Name references.
ryo reports tuple swaps (model, dependency = dependency, model; d, now = now, d) as self-assignment; Ruff compares element by position.

import section classification differs: Ruff treats the file's own top-level package (template_tests) as first-party and flags, ryo does not; the 4 extras are django/ files importing their own package (options.py, sql/query.py, http/request.py).
ryo flags for-yield loops whose target name is also bound by other loops in the function (paginator.py page); Ruff skips when the target is referenced outside the loop.
ryo does not honour the module-level __getattr__ in django/core/mail/__init__.py; Ruff skips undefined-export when the module defines __getattr__.
ryo flags write-in-loop where the loop target name (part) is reused by neighbouring loops; suspected the same name-versus-binding scope difference as UP028, unconfirmed.
ryo flags an implicitly concatenated string that has its own parentheses as the first element of an unparenthesised returned tuple (mysql/operations.py); Ruff treats it as parenthesised.

ryo compares the loop target with the parameter name; Ruff compares with the current binding, so it skips when the argument was already rebound locally (forms/fields.py initial, core/exceptions.py message).
ryo treats the function parameter sql in def mogrify(sql, ...) as redefining the module import sql (psycopg_any.py); Ruff does not, since the parameter is in a different scope.
ryo treats the blanket # NOQA on line 1 of db/models/sql/__init__.py (star import) as used; Ruff reports it unused. Suspected: a suppressed ryo-only finding on that line, unverified.
ryo misses .format() on a multi-line implicit concatenation that repeats positional indexes ({1}, {2} reused) in db/migrations/loader.py.
